description: Search the tools available to your account by keyword. Returns matching tools with their names, descriptions and input schemas: the same tools tools/list advertises to you, nothing more. Use it to find which tool fits a request. Keywords can be: a tool name fragment (e.g. "chart"), a domain (africa, vertical, piracy, creator, sports), or an action (list, get, compare).
name: search_tools

outputSchema.description: Tool-specific result object. Inspect the `content` array for human-readable text and structured data.
